p1: I am applying for the **Data Engineer** role. You need reporting data that arrives on time and that teams can trust, and I build exactly that: scheduled, tested Python pipelines that people rely on every morning.
p2: Your first need is moving reporting off manual spreadsheets. At **Northwind Analytics** I replaced the team's weekly spreadsheet reports with scheduled **Python** ETL jobs on **AWS**, tested in CI with **GitHub Actions**. The reports now arrive without anyone running them. I can do the same for your client reporting, starting with the reports that take the most manual time today.
p3: Your second need is clean data from several sources. At **Brightline Logistics** I merged data from three legacy systems into one reporting database, and built the **Power BI** dashboards depot managers used each morning. That work taught me to check data at the point it enters a pipeline, which is where most reporting errors start.
p5: I take ownership of what I build and keep it running after launch. I wrote my team's code review guide and run regular knowledge-sharing sessions. I hold a BSc in Computer Science from the University of Leeds, and I can start with one month's notice.
p6: I would welcome a conversation about how your team plans to move client reporting onto the new data platform.
